trial.program_source:
def transform(grid):
 from collections import Counter
 h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0]); out=[r[:] for r in grid]
 counts=Counter(v for row in grid for v in row if v)
 if not counts:return out
 base=counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
 cr=max(range(h),key=lambda r:sum(v==base for v in grid[r]))
 cc=max(range(w),key=lambda c:sum(grid[r][c]==base for r in range(h)))
 pts=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] not in (0,base)]
 if not pts:return out
 r,c=min(pts,key=lambda p:((p[0]-cr)**2+(p[1]-cc)**2,p))
 nr,nc=cr+c-cc,cc-(r-cr)
 if 0<=nr<h and 0<=nc<w:
  out[r][c]=0
  out[nr][nc]=grid[r][c]
 return out
